limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: the 28 KO-arm runs are not annotated: QHF_00014373-14375, 14378-14383, 14393, 14394, 14397, 14398, 14403-14406, 14411-14414, 14503-14506, 14508-14510 (raw names MDB468_KO_* / KO_*; MaxQuant experiments MB468_KO_6h/24h/48h/72h-b-t, KO_Ctrl-1..3, KO_TreatSwap_*). The only stated map (light = MTX, heavy = control) fails the rule-6 data check for every KO experiment: the MTX signature is in HEAVY in KO_<t> (DHFR +0.1..+2.6, TYMS +0.2..+1.1, SOD2 +0.4..+1.8 median-centred log2 H/L) and in LIGHT in KO_TreatSwap; KO_Ctrl is not ~0 (TK1 -1.0..-1.8); MTHFD2 is lower in heavy in 22 of the 25 KO experiments with a value (all 3 KO_Ctrl and all 6 quantified KO_TreatSwap included) regardless of treatment, while SCR experiments track only the MTX effect, so channel genotype is also unclear. Neither the paper nor PRIDE describes the KO/SCR SILAC design or names the knocked-out gene. Section added to annotations/BLOCKED.md.
KO_48h-1-2 has two deposited raws (QHF_00014380 'MDB468_KO_48h-1-2' and rerun QHF_00014503 'KO_48h-1-2'); which was searched is unknown (no summary.txt). Moot for this SDRF (KO arm excluded).

Genotype of the 'SCR' cells is not stated for the proteomics. The paper uses both a CRISPR scramble_gRNA control (for MTHFD2 KO) and pGIPZ-shSCR (shRNA); no genotype/modification column is written and 'SCR' appears only in source names (the submitter's run label).

Untreated controls: sampling time = 'not available'. Whether each control culture was harvested in parallel with its MTX time point is not stated. Controls get 14 distinct source names / biological replicate numbers (one per mixture channel); whether the heavy controls of different time points came from one culture is not stated, so the independence of these 14 is an assumption.
Technical vs biological status of TreatSwap -1/-2 and Ctrl -1/-2 is inferred from identical per-experiment median raw H/L (same mixture), not stated.

No MaxQuant mqpar.xml / parameters.txt / summary.txt deposited: modifications and tolerances are from the paper/PRIDE Methods only; the 'formylated residue' in PRIDE identifiedPTMStrings has no support in the paper or the proteinGroups site columns and is not annotated. PRIDE protocol says 'mus musculus database'; paper says Homo sapiens and the protein IDs are human (paper wins).

Paper/PRIDE Methods vs raw method conflicts, raw wins: NCE 25 (not 28), MS1 resolution 60,000 (not 70,000), isolation window 1.2 m/z (not 1.4), charge exclusion 1 and >=6 (not 2-7 sampled). Only NCE is an SDRF column.

Culture medium is stated (DMEM-F12 SILAC medium) but no NCIT/OBI term exists for DMEM/F-12 (OLS searches logged); OBI 'Dulbecco's modified Eagle medium' is a different medium, so characteristics[culture medium] = 'not available'.
MTX dose (50 nM) is not encoded in any column.
